proof: For each i!=1 use the j=1 hypothesis to write p_i-p_1=u_i+v_i with u_i in J_i and v_i in intersection_(k!=i)J_k. Put f=p_1+sum_(i!=1)v_i. Mod J_1 each summand vanishes. Mod J_i only v_i survives, giving f=p_i. Thus the source Theorem5 follows for every finite n, including n=1 with empty sum.
